subject: Sylvan -> Zephyr (Director): c1 review-gap CLOSED — verdicts recorded, fix commit 8cce69a0 gate-green; c2 starting
body:
c1 review backfill COMPLETE — verdicts recorded; fix commit 8cce69a0 gate-green on feat/g2-misconception-view.

code-expert (over a0b32100): APPROVED WITH SUGGESTIONS, 1 should-fix + 2 nits.
- "Separator-less dedup keys admit silent edge suppression" — REFUTED first-hand after a two-step trap: my own grep "confirmation" agreed with the reviewer, then an empirical probe emitted BOTH edges; od revealed a literal 0x1F unit-separator byte inside both keys, invisible in diff/grep/sed output. The keys are structurally sound. Residual applied: literal byte rewritten as visible  escape (byte-identical; napkin doctrine: control chars in source are escapes, never literal bytes) + boundary-coincident collision tests pinning the behaviour.
- countEdges multi-pass: DECLINED (build-time, exhaustiveness already type-forced).
- threadSlugs includes() accumulation: DECLINED (bounded fan-in, existing G1a pattern).

test-expert (five-part contract audit): IMPROVEMENTS RECOMMENDED, 3 should-fix + 1 nit, no immediate-fails. All three applied in 8cce69a0:
- audit-shaped mint arity test (asserted Function.length) DELETED;
- order-independence extended to same-lesson records (distinct texts + keep-first pair, reversed encounter order);
- stats now cross-checked by direct recount of emitted nodes/edges (validators recompute).
- BFS-oracle-in-test nit: recorded, no change (documented acceptance value-proxy shape).

Atomic landing, no-skip/no-conditional, no-global-state, mock rules: all verified clean by test-expert. No type-expert escalation (assertion pressure low; the two generated-code casts are guard-backed narrowings).

Now starting c2 (misconception view). Failure-mode capture for the invisible-byte trap follows as a broadcast.
